saw_lines: Electronics buyers compare an open box unit against the new price, and trust it only when the condition is spelled out.
So the sale is won or lost on the first screen, where price and warranty must be read fast.
Your site already leads with a minimum 30% off and 2982 reviews, so open your next Google text ads with both numbers and the warranty line.
